name: Seongmin Chang
today: I'm a Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Warmblood, building Monocle AI and SafetySnap. My work lives in the edges — the connections nobody thought to draw.
Previously, I worked at Yonsei University as an AI researcher. I've learnt to build LLM from scratch here.
While our products serve thousands of users in Korea with the latest technology, I'm studying applied maths at the University of Toronto to stay grounded in the fundamentals underneath it all.
You can reach me via LinkedIn or email.
